_comment: Source URLs for UPSC Civil Services (Main) question papers, used by
scripts/backfill_pyq_paper_provenance.py to satisfy the provenance gate on
POST /pyq-papers/{id}/review (pending -> verified needs a non-empty
source_url or a source_document_id).
PROVENANCE LEVEL: listing, not per-year. UPSC does not publish a per-year
landing page for Mains question papers. URLs of the shape
/examinations/Civil Services (Main) Examination, <year> appear in search
results but redirect to the site homepage, so they are NOT usable anchors —
an earlier revision of this file wrongly marked them verified on the
strength of search-index presence alone. Every year therefore points at the
same official archives listing: a reviewer reaches the right corpus and
locates the year themselves.
Direct PDFs exist (e.g. /sites/default/files/QP-CSM-22-GENERAL-STUDIES-PAPER I-190922.pdf)
but each names ONE paper, while one pyq_papers row holds GS1-4 + Essay for a
whole year — a single PDF would describe the row incorrectly.
UPGRADE PATH: upload the five PDFs per year and set source_document_id.
That is the only anchor that is both precise and correct; until then this
file is deliberately honest about being listing-level.
verified=true means the URL was confirmed to resolve to a real page — by
loading it, not by seeing it in search results.
